Name: Do It For Mirren
Author: bezajel
Description:
Does your obsession for Mirren match his for you? Make your own creepy shrine to your favourite yandere florist.


[size=4][b]How to get the poster[/b][/size]
I thought it would be weird to just - buy - the poster. So I made it craftable. But because you can't craft furniture, there's a bit of a process (under spoiler):

[spoiler]
[list]
[*]You can craft the [b]Do It For Mirren Collage[/b] with 2 sunflowers, 2 soggy newspaper, and 1 copper ore.[/*]
[*]The collage can be taken to Pierre who will 'laminate' it for you - exchanging it for the full resolution [b]Do It For Mirren Poster[/b], which is a furniture item that can be placed on the wall.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]



[b][size=4]Gift taste + special dialogue[/size][/b]
[size=3]The collage item is a small object - it can be placed on tables or on the floor (not passable, use pickaxe to pick up), and can be gifted. It's not worth anything if you sell it. There are unique gift responses for a few NPCs (including Mirren). I also added a conversation topic for getting the poster.[/size]

[spoiler]The collage is a [b]Universal Dislike[/b], with the following exceptions:

- Mirren likes it (he doesn't love that you found photos of him, but he loves that you're into him)
- Emily, Evelyn, and Penny are neutral
- Seb and Shane hate it

There is unique gift dialogue for Mirren, Abigail, Elliott, Emily, Evelyn, Haley, Penny, Sebastian, Shane.
Hopefully the dialogue hits true regardless of route and progress through the mod, but hit me up if it's way off.

When you get the poster, there is special dialogue for Abigail (available immediately) and Mirren (from the next day).[/spoiler]


[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Unzip and place in your Mods folder. Content Patcher is the only requirement, but why would you use this without [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39733]Mirren The Florist[/url]?
